keys.results.<point>.<design>.<task>.<cond>.s: mean with 95% clip-bootstrap CI (1000 resamples of test clips; all rows of a clip together). design: block2 (v1 held block: 2 dir bins x 2 interior speed bins), block3 (3 x 3), cross (2 dir bins at ALL speeds and 2 speed bins at ALL directions unseen: target theta and speed both unseen in any fitting step). Seeds 0-3 = four block positions, pooled.
keys.tasks: joint (both variables to a held-out cell; carriers = test clips outside every held dir and speed bin), direction (block designs only; carriers in the target speed bin outside held dir bins), speed (block designs only; carriers in the target dir bin outside held speed bins), joint_path (sheet vs straight chord between the sheet's endpoints, path metrics at K=11 waypoints), reader_floor (readers applied to the real test clips of the target cell), dose_direction / dose_speed (block2; edit scaled by the dose), extrapolate (speed-only to values beyond the training max; no hold-out).
keys.cond: own = each arm's own edit; matched = every arm's endpoint displacement rescaled per clip to the sheet's norm (the probe_edit arm is a min-norm edit, so compare it at own norm and via sheet_at_probe_edit_norm).
keys.arms (joint): sheet = TPS P(theta_t, v_t) - P(theta_s, v_s); seq_global = global ring (pooled over speeds) + global speed line (pooled over directions), additive (orders share the endpoint); seq_local_dir_then_speed = ring of the source speed bin + speed line of the target direction window (3 dir bins); seq_local_speed_then_dir = speed line of the source direction window + ring of the target speed bin (nearest seen bin in cross); ring_src_only = source-band ring only; chord_cells_idw = difference of means, target estimated by inverse-distance weighting of the 4 nearest seen cells (non-oracle Goodfire linear baseline); chord_cells_ORACLE = difference of means to the knot clips INSIDE the held cell (uses held-out data; upper bound for the linear baseline); probe_edit = minimum-norm edit hitting a (sin, cos, v) ridge fit on knot clips in PCA-64; abl_* = cone factorial of the sheet (radius_frozen: ring keeps the source radius; shape_frozen: ring shape of the source speed; global_speed_axis: both frozen = sheet axis c(v) + source-speed ring; cylinder_from_sheet: sheet axis + the sheet averaged over speed).
keys.arms (direction): ring1d_band = v1 ring of the target speed band; ring_band_pm1 = ring over the band and its seen neighbours; ring_global = ring pooled over all speeds; ring_global_radius_scaled = ring_global x rho(v_target)/rho(mean v); sheet_pooled_over_speed = the TPS averaged over speed (same smoothing, no speed-specific slice); sheet_slice_other_speed = the TPS slice at the mirrored speed 2*v_mid - v.
keys.metrics: err_dir (deg) / err_spd (m/s; m/s^2 for acceleration) = ridge reader (probe folds 3+4 outside every held clip) error vs the target cell's mean; _f3/_f4 = readers fit on fold 3 only / fold 4 only; _mlp = MLP reader (PCA-64 whitened, 128 hidden, lbfgs, alpha 1); leak_spd / leak_dir = change of the other variable's ridge readout vs the unedited clip; leak_pos = change of the ridge start-position (x, y) readout (normalised arena units); nearest_real_R = 1 - |x'-mu|/|x-mu|, mu = mean of the target cell's test clips; dir_radius = |(sin, cos)| of the direction reader; achieved_frac = achieved change / intended change (dose).
keys.acceleration: same analysis on the acceleration set (acceleration x direction sheet), points 12 and 21; 'spd' fields are acceleration (m/s^2).
keys.spline per arm: sheet = thin-plate-spline RBF (scipy RBFInterpolator, kernel thin_plate_spline, degree-1 polynomial) over (cos theta, sin theta, lambda*(v-v_mid)/v_half) fit to knot cell centroids (16 dir x 8 speed bins, >=2 clips); lambda in {0.5,1,2} and smoothing in {0,0.1,1,10} chosen by reconstructing the other seeds' held cells (this seed's block removed first); it SMOOTHS when the chosen smoothing > 0 (chosen values in seeds[].geo). sheet_tps_interp = same TPS with smoothing 0 (interpolating). ring1d_band / ring_global / ring_band_pm1 / seq_global / seq_local_* / speedline_* = OUR stored FITPACK splrep smoother (spline='smooth', s=m; known flawed, REPORT 4.3); *_interp = the paper's interpolating spline through the raw centroids (periodic cubic, labels angle = value-ordered knots; natural cubic with linear extension for speed); *_reinschcv = causalab SplineManifold Reinsch smoothing with lambda by leave-block-out CV on the kept knots (scripts/run_endpoint_diagnosis.py cv_lambda + causalab_curve, block=2 knots, margin=1); seq_global_reinschcv_ring_interp_line = Reinsch-CV ring + interpolating speed line.

extras.note: extras computed on the first run (identical for the arms named; the rerun only added arms)
